rec.name: Cart Shipping Progress Bar with Free Gift Milestones
rec.status: Built — launched (Focal theme; documented in Slite)

what.text: A progress bar for the cart drawer and cart page that shows how much more the customer must spend to reach milestones: free shipping, a free gift, and a second free gift or automatic discount. Each milestone has its own icon marker on the bar. A dynamic message ('Only $X left until free shipping') updates as the cart value changes. When a threshold is reached, the customer can add a free gift from a gift-product block (optionally a slider of several gifts). The original brief asked for up to 5 goals, but the shipped build covers free shipping plus 2 gift tiers.

why.text: The goal-gradient effect: people accelerate as they approach a visible goal. A bar that shows remaining spend turns the free-shipping or gift threshold into a concrete target and encourages adding items to the cart, which lifts AOV. Several milestones keep motivation going after the first goal is reached. Gift icons add a reward and reciprocity element, and 'free' framing reduces perceived cost. Showing the bar in the cart means the nudge arrives at a high-intent moment.

how.text: Built for the Focal theme (code was not written for other themes, so other themes need adjustments). 1) Add a 'Shipping Progress Bar' settings group to settings_schema.json under cart settings: text color, active bar color, rest-of-bar color, rounded/square border, shipping icon (HTML), and a 'show free shipping minimum' checkbox. 2) Add a 'Cart Free Gift' settings group: display toggle, enable free item, headline, threshold, product_list of gift products, auto-add, gift icon, before/after messages with an [amount] placeholder, text and background colors, and the same fields for a 'Second Free Gift' with its own threshold, icon, messages, products and auto-add. 3) In the cart drawer, replace the content before the mini-cart form with Liquid that calculates thresholds (multi-currency via 'EUR:50,USD:60'), excludes non-shippable items, and renders a <free-shipping-bar> whose --progress CSS variable is cart total / max threshold. Icons are placed at left:% positions per threshold, and the message switches by the current stage. 4) Create the snippet free-gift-cart.liquid, which lists gift products (image, title, compare-at price, 'free for you', add button). It hides gifts already in the cart and shows the second-tier gifts only after the first gift is in the cart. The installation walkthrough was shared as a video, not as written steps. Discount logic: the second gift needs a matching automatic discount code created in Shopify.

items: Free shipping threshold (multi-currency, e.g. EUR:50,USD:60) and show/hide toggle
Text color, active bar color, rest-of-bar color
Progress bar corner style (rounded/square)
Icons per milestone: shipping, gift 1, gift 2 (HTML/SVG)
Enable free gift 1 / enable second free gift
Threshold amount per gift tier
Gift products per tier (product list)
Auto-add gift to cart (per tier)
Messages before and after reaching each threshold, with [amount] placeholder
Gift block headline, text color, background color
'Display section' toggle, with a CSS override (.cart-free-gift{display:block !important}) for A/B tests
Free shipping message text via language editor (cart.general.free_shipping_remaining_html)

dependencies.text: Focal theme (cart drawer: mini-cart-form, <free-shipping-bar> custom element and its JS/CSS are theme-specific). Free shipping rates must be configured in Shopify. The second gift needs an automatic discount code in Shopify, with its threshold matched to the section setting. Gift products need a price or compare-at price to show correctly. The ticket text suggests a tag-based approach to make gift products free and hide them elsewhere in the shop. The shipped code does not show this, so it is unverified. Custom JS for add/remove of gifts (the .free-gift-action handler) is not included in the supplied code. Snippet code is truncated at the end.

items: Average order value (AOV)
Share of carts reaching the free shipping threshold
Share of carts reaching gift thresholds
Free gift add rate
Cart-to-checkout rate
Conversion rate
Revenue per visitor
Cart abandonment rate
